query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.totalHours,
  p.usedHours,
  p.deductedMinutes,
  p.isActive,
  (p.usedHours - p.totalHours) * 60 as outOfPackageMinutes,
  r.firstName,
  r.lastName
FROM packages p
JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka'
ORDER BY p.id DESC
LIMIT 5;
